scope: Research-only original-source comparison of nascent ribosome assembly versus continuous self-replacement and cis-encoded translation

sources.title: In vitro integration of ribosomal RNA synthesis, ribosome assembly, and translation
sources.authors: Jewett MC, Fritz BR, Timmerman LE, Church GM
sources.study_independence: Distinct experimental program; prior mechanistic predecessor, not independent reproduction of later whole-ribosome biogenesis
sources.grade: E2 accessible original main Methods/Results/Discussion inspected; supplement and raw observations not independently reprocessed
sources.rights: PMC original identifies CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; source text paraphrased, no figure or data copying
sources.positive: New rRNA cotranscribed/assembled with purified native ribosomal proteins in S150 extract; assembled 50S from new 23S RNA supports firefly luciferase output; mutant rRNA confers functional antibiotic resistance
sources.quantitative: Integrated 50S iSAT 0.63 ± 0.10 nmol/l Fluc at four hours versus approximately 3.2 nmol/l from matched mature-rRNA assembly reference (about 20%); Fig 2 at least four independent reactions
sources.negative_and_controls: No 23S gene control had no detectable Fluc; isolated pretranscribed/purified 23S RNA led to roughly 200-fold less output; some later optimization failed to improve coupled result; contamination rRNA investigated
external_dependencies: Native ribosomal proteins purified from native ribosomal subunits
Existing natural complementary ribosomal subunits in important assay arms
E. coli S150 derived extract containing nonregenerated auxiliary machinery
not_demonstrated: De novo synthesis of all ribosomal proteins in same reaction
Full machinery renewal without active native subunits
Ribosome daughter lineages or endogenous template propagation

sources.title: Autonomous ribosome biogenesis in vitro
sources.authors: Kosaka Y, Miyawaki Y, Mori M et al.
sources.study_independence: Different team and experiment from 2013 iSAT, but builds on that mechanism; not an E3 independent replication of complete self-reproduction
sources.grade: E2 original main Methods/Results/Discussion/statistics/rights inspected; source data and supplementary image series not independently reanalyzed
sources.rights: Publisher original CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; no adaptation/distribution of figures or supplemental source
sources.positive: Expressed three rRNAs and 54 ribosomal proteins in a prepared S150 extract with 80 nM native ribosome seed; nascent SSU and LSU identified via orthogonality, antibiotic selection, isotope and mutant-protein controls; purified mixed new subunits functioned
sources.quantitative: Authors' reporter-calibrated equivalent yields 9.8 nM small and 3 nM large from 80 nM initial native; roughly 12% and 3.8%; authors state at least 26-fold productivity improvement needed for one-for-one renewal; selected assays n=3 biological replicates
sources.negative_and_controls: Initial SSU conditions showed no detectable function; greater DNA concentration hindered yield rather than helping; first droplet assay native background signal required additional selectivity; salts nonphysiological reduced success; no artificial aptamer-rRNA control lost double-antibiotic signal
external_dependencies: 80 nM natural ribosomal starting seed in key paired-subunit studies
Pre-made E. coli S150 soluble extract with accessory ribosome biogenesis factors
Optimized ionic conditions and operator-run separate functional assay
not_demonstrated: Repeated ribosome generations without initial native seed
tRNA accessory-protein and full template self-renewal
Dividing synthetic cells with heritable constructor

sources.title: Rewiring the ribosome to translate proteins encoded in its own RNA
sources.authors: Alizadeh K, Klepacki D, Vázquez-Laslop N, Mankin AS
sources.program: University of Illinois Chicago Mankin ribosome cis-translation
sources.study_independence: Distinct biological construct and lab, not replication of de novo ribosome assembly
sources.grade: E1 original publisher abstract, figure descriptions and metadata; complete main Methods/results gated during this review
sources.rights: Article full redistribution license not established; PCT/US2025/047444 patent interest disclosed by named authors; original paraphrase only
sources.positive: Reports Ribo-M and Ribo-TM ribosomes translating polypeptide coding sequence on chimeric ribosomal RNA, with mutation/antibiotic controls supporting in-cis function
sources.quantitative: No credible numerical efficacy or biological-replicate statement from reviewed accessible source; omit estimates
sources.negative_and_controls: Abstract reports in-cis translation abolished by small-subunit impairing mutations/antibiotics; specific replicate counts, selective failures and exclusions not independently audited
external_dependencies: Engineered chimeric messenger-rRNA and preexisting 30S/50S/tethered ribosome configuration
Externally supplied cellular or cell-free biosynthesis system
No shown regenerated ribosome/protein/transmitted genome inventory
not_demonstrated: De novo reproduction of encoded ribosome
Self-synthesis of complete ribosomal replacement machinery

complete_source_rights_and_provenance: Source DOI/date/version/access tiers recorded; rights differ and publisher HTML for 2026 full article not independently accessible.
distinct_from_pass42: Pass 42 studied non-ribosomal translation factors, co-expression and a subset of aaRS; Pass 43 studies directly new functional ribosomal subunits and cis-encoding, with turnover/lineage limits.
